scope: Review every exact current CLUE and UNIQUE row. Category, subcategory, tab, and semantic roles are independently assessed.
evidenceRules: Use only the exact numeric item ID parsed from a pinned item infobox variant and the article text at that pinned revision.
An item is not loot merely because it came from a reward table or appears in a Collection Log.
A Collection Log link alone does not establish a trophy, pet, combat role, or bank destination.
Combat equipment, functional clue gear, cosmetic style, and pets may have overlapping roles; preserve each directly documented role.
Do not propagate mechanics between item IDs from a page title, family, group, or variant pool. Each ID needs its own exact parsed variant.
Certify the current category/subcategory/tab only when exact article content supports the retained primary role. Otherwise use unresolved and explain the evidence gap.
pendingProductPolicyReason: These zero-stat wearable quest items have directly documented quest use and appearance retention. The product policy must decide which role drives their primary category; until then keep their exact article facts as independent roles and leave the assignment unresolved.

roleRules.combat_equipment: Add only when the exact item's Infobox Bonuses contains a nonzero equipment statistic. An equipable flag alone means equipable, not combat-effective.
roleRules.functional_clue_utility: Add only when article text directly describes a clue requirement, clue step, or clue-solving use.
roleRules.quest_required_item: Record the exact item article's quest-item or direct quest-use statement independently from cosmetic, combat, and clue roles.
roleRules.cosmetic_or_style_retention: Use article evidence for appearance, clothing, costume, color/style choice, or wearable form. Do not infer it from clue reward origin.
roleRules.pet_companion: Use only when the exact item article describes a pet, follower, or companion. Keep adult and puppy states as distinct exact-ID roles.
roleRules.pet_stage_adult: Use for an exact pet item article that identifies an adult dog companion.
roleRules.pet_stage_puppy: Use for an exact pet item article that identifies a puppy companion.
roleRules.collection_log_member: Record only a direct positive Collection log items article category. This is an independent role and does not imply loot status or a Collection Log tab.
roleRules.display_trophy: Use only for an actual display or trophy mechanic. Collection Log membership by itself is never sufficient.
roleRules.reward_container_or_drop: Require article text about opening/contents/rewards or an explicitly described reward-drop function.
roleRules.access_or_reward_key: Require item-specific key/access mechanics. Distinguish access keys from keys that open reward containers.
roleRules.equipment_upgrade_material: Require item-specific equipment upgrade, combination, enhancement, infusion, or attachment mechanics.
roleRules.equipment_charge_resource: Require item-specific charge, recharge, or depletion mechanics tied to equipment or a combat ability.
roleRules.salvaging_or_recovery_relic: Require item-specific salvage, repair, restoration, or recovery mechanics.

uniquePredicateBySubcategory.reward-container: Place this exact container with boss/reward supplies only when its article describes opening it or its contents/rewards.
uniquePredicateBySubcategory.reward-drop: Place this exact item with boss/reward items only when its page describes a reward-drop or opening mechanic.
uniquePredicateBySubcategory.reward-key: Place this exact key with reward-opening tools only when its page describes the chest/container or reward it opens.
uniquePredicateBySubcategory.boss-access-key: Place this exact key with boss access tools only when its page documents the encounter, door, or area it unlocks.
uniquePredicateBySubcategory.key-material: Place this exact item as key material only when its article documents combining it into a key.
uniquePredicateBySubcategory.equipment-upgrade: Place this exact item with equipment upgrade materials only when the article documents the upgrade or attachment workflow.
uniquePredicateBySubcategory.weapon-upgrade: Place this exact item with weapon upgrade materials only when the article documents the weapon change or construction workflow.
uniquePredicateBySubcategory.equipment-charge: Place this exact item with combat charge resources only when the article documents charging, recharging, or depletion in use.
uniquePredicateBySubcategory.salvaging-relic: Place this exact item as a salvage/recovery relic only when the article documents how it is salvaged, restored, repaired, or recovered.
